summary: Israeli forces continue intensive operations in South Lebanon with the 401st Brigade seizing over 150 weapons and destroying 90+ Hezbollah infrastructures in Haddatha, while daily alert data shows 195 alerts and 185 drone sightings across southern Lebanon. Hamas announces dissolution of its Gaza governing committee to transfer authority to a technocratic body, though Israeli officials dismiss the move as a spin with members remaining in place. French President Macron arrives in Damascus for the first Western leader visit since Assad's fall, meeting Syria's new leadership to discuss reconstruction.
key_points: IDF 401st Brigade Combat Team seized 150+ weapons including RPGs, anti-tank missiles, and Kalashnikovs, destroyed 90+ terror infrastructures, and killed 20+ militants in Haddatha village, South Lebanon over the past month. (Source: @idf_telegram/24532)

Lebanon daily statistics for July 6 show 195 alerts, 185 drone sightings, 3 drone strikes (Kfar Tibnit, Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Barishit) and 6 artillery shelling incidents (Al-Qusayr 2, Barishit 1, Al-Qantara 1, Kounin 1, Houla 1). (Source: @redlinkleb/30345)

Hamas declares its Gaza government resigning to make way for a technocratic committee; Israeli official calls it a spin with all members staying in their positions. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93353, @presstv/197262, @New_security8200/202242)

French President Macron lands in Damascus for first Western leader visit since Assad's fall, meets Syrian leader Ahmed al-Sharaa, accompanied by TotalEnergies and CMA CGM executives to discuss reconstruction. (Source: @SharghDaily/170279, @asafroz/51046)

IDF strikes vehicle with 4 suspects approaching security zone near Al-Aqida in South Lebanon, and separately strikes 5 militants rebuilding underground infrastructure in North Gaza. (Source: @New_security8200/202246, @inon_yttach/9287)

Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei's funeral preparations underway at Jamkaran Mosque in Qom; foreign media estimate 12-20 million attendees; Iraqi cities Karbala and Najaf suspend work for ceremonies. (Source: @shin_persian/7406, @SharghDaily/170282, @naya_foriraq/81255)
Open-source intelligence reports Iranian proxies in Iraq have acquired cruise missiles, raising regional threat profile. (Source: @shin_persian/7405)
Lebanese President states he will not meet Netanyahu, informs US and Qatar that a senior officer in South Lebanon will oversee ceasefire between Beirut and Tel Aviv. (Source: @SharghDaily/170291)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli military operations in South Lebanon remain intense with the 401st Brigade achieving operational control in Haddatha, seizing over 150 weapons and eliminating 20+ Hezbollah militants over the past month. Hamas announces dissolution of its Gaza governing committee to transfer authority to a technocratic body, though Israeli officials dismiss the move as a tactical spin with all members retaining positions. French President Macron's historic visit to Damascus marks the first Western leader engagement since Assad's fall, signaling potential geopolitical shifts in Syria's reconstruction.

points: Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei's funeral preparations are centered at Jamkaran Mosque in Qom, with the mosque expecting his body soon for mass ceremonies attended by Shia pilgrims praying for the 12th Imam's reappearance. (Source: @shin_persian/7406)

Foreign media outlets including Financial Times (12 million), Al-Ahd (15 million), and Wall Street Journal (20 million) acknowledge millions-strong attendance at Khamenei's funeral, contrasting previous characterizations of Iranian gatherings as thousands or tens of thousands. (Source: @SharghDaily/170282)

Iraqi provinces Karbala and Najaf suspend official work on Wednesday to facilitate participation in Khamenei funeral ceremonies, reflecting cross-border Shia mobilization. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81255, @naya_foriraq/81253)
IRGC Quds Force commander attends Khamenei's funeral in Tehran, underscoring the Revolutionary Guards' central role in the succession process. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93354)
Claims circulate of widespread Houthi terrorist presence in a Tehran mosque, though the source appears politically opposed to the Iranian regime. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74819)
Open-source intelligence indicates Iranian-backed proxies in Iraq have acquired cruise missiles, representing a significant escalation in proxy capabilities. (Source: @shin_persian/7405)

Anti-regime commentary from Iranian opposition channels describes chaotic scenes at funeral processions, allegations of empty coffins, and women fainting, but these claims lack independent verification. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74814, @rodast_omiddana/74810, @rodast_omiddana/74808)

IDF 401st Brigade Combat Team under 91st Division achieves operational control in Haddatha village, South Lebanon, seizing 150+ weapons including RPG rockets, anti-tank missiles, machine guns, and Kalashnikovs, destroying 90+ terror infrastructures and killing 20+ militants over the past month. (Source: @idf_telegram/24532)

Israeli Air Force conducts routine training for wings ceremony from Monday to Thursday in Beersheba and western Negev airspace, with increased aircraft movement noted as standard activity. (Source: @New_security8200/202232)

Israeli official dismisses Hamas government resignation as a spin, stating all members remain in their positions and the move aims to avoid accusations of violating ceasefire agreements. (Source: @New_security8200/202242)
IDF strikes 5 militants in North Gaza attempting to rebuild underground infrastructure over the weekend, according to military correspondent Yinnon Shalom Yetech. (Source: @inon_yttach/9287)
Former US President Trump threatens Iran: either make a deal or the US will complete the mission, stating it would not be difficult. (Source: @amitsegal/62801, @lelotsenzura/93355)
Axios reports Netanyahu asked Trump to restrain Erdogan, expressing concern over US weapons sales that would modernize the Turkish air force. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374902)
Knesset approves first reading of a national inquiry committee by MKs for the October 7 massacre, with opposition boycotting the vote. (Source: @amitsegal/62811)

Hamas announces its Gaza governing committee resigns to make way for a technocratic committee, with Press TV reporting from Deir al-Balah that authority transfer preparations are underway. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93353, @presstv/197262)

Israeli official characterizes Hamas resignation as a meaningless spin since all members remain in their positions, suggesting the move is designed to avoid ceasefire violation accusations. (Source: @New_security8200/202242)
IDF strikes 5 militants in North Gaza who were attempting to rebuild underground infrastructure over the weekend, per military correspondent Yinnon Shalom Yetech. (Source: @inon_yttach/9287)
British lawmakers urge UK government to sanction Netanyahu and ministers over alleged torture of Palestinian civilians, with dozens signing the call. (Source: @presstv/197264)
No specific West Bank operations mentioned in the current message set beyond the North Gaza strike.

French President Macron arrives in Damascus for first Western leader visit since Assad's fall in 2024, meeting Syrian leader Ahmed al-Sharaa to discuss reconstruction of 13-year war devastation. (Source: @SharghDaily/170279, @asafroz/51042, @yediotnews25/132328)
Macron accompanied by executives from TotalEnergies and CMA CGM, signaling French corporate engagement in Syrian infrastructure and shipping reconstruction. (Source: @SharghDaily/170279)

sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo in South Lebanon remains high with daily drone and artillery exchanges, IDF ground forces consolidating control in Haddatha, and Hezbollah attempting to maintain pressure through drone surveillance. Hamas's announced governmental restructuring appears designed to navigate ceasefire compliance while retaining de facto control, a tactic Israel explicitly rejects. Iran's proxy network expansion into cruise missile capabilities in Iraq represents a qualitative escalation in regional strike reach, potentially threatening US and Israeli assets. The Macron visit to Damascus signals Western willingness to engage Syria's new leadership, which could alter the balance of influence away from Iran if reconstruction aid materializes. Khamenei's funeral mobilizes massive Shia transnational networks, reinforcing Iran's ideological reach but also exposing potential succession vulnerabilities.
sections.regional_response: Lebanon's president leverages US and Qatari channels to institutionalize ceasefire monitoring, seeking to internationalize the southern border security framework. Qatar's inclusion as a mediator reflects its established role in Hamas-Israel negotiations. France's high-profile engagement with Syria's al-Sharaa government, accompanied by major energy and logistics firms, aims to preempt Russian and Iranian dominance in reconstruction. The UK parliamentary push for Netanyahu sanctions indicates growing European political pressure over Palestinian treatment. Arab states' silence on Khamenei's funeral contrasts with Iraqi Shia mobilization, highlighting sectarian fault lines. Turkey's potential F-16 modernization via US sales, opposed by Israel, adds a NATO dimension to regional arms dynamics.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 33% drone strike conversion rate in Lebanon suggests either effective Israeli air defense or selective engagement rules. Haddatha's transformation from Hezbollah hub to IDF-controlled zone with documented weapons caches provides tangible evidence of Hezbollah's degraded southern infrastructure. Hamas's technocratic committee proposal mirrors previous Palestinian Authority reform attempts that failed to satisfy Israeli security demands. Macron's delegation including TotalEnergies and CMA CGM indicates concrete commercial follow-through beyond diplomatic symbolism. The cruise missile claim for Iraqi proxies, if verified, would mark the first such capability for Iranian-backed groups outside Yemen, requiring urgent technical verification. Khamenei funeral attendance figures vary wildly between state-aligned and opposition sources, complicating assessment of regime cohesion.
